samples.question: The image is a 32x32 field of gray-noise blocks; every block has the same mean brightness, but a coarse diagonal band is hidden in the local texture: inside the band each block carries a strong checkerboard modulation, outside it a low-dispersion gray noise. Compute the local luminance VARIANCE of every block so the high-texture blocks light up and the band appears. Which diagonal band is revealed, the rising band A or the falling band B? Answer A or B.
